The '''Talus Imperial Outpost''', also known as the '''Imperial Military Outpost''', was a major installation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Double Worlds|Twin]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. From above, the Talus Imperial Outpost resembled the [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crest]].<ref name="SWG:IO" />

==History==
{{Quote|Black Epsilon is stationed at the Imperial Base on Talus, as Corellia itself is officially neutral... for now. There are reports of considerable Rebel activity in the area, as you can imagine.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Landau]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the populations of the planets of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] were sympathetic towards the cause of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The Empire had therefore placed well-maintained fortified garrisons on these worlds, including the Imperial Outpost on Talus, in order to repress any uprising before it could take place.<ref name="SWG:IO" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] special unit [[Black Epsilon]] was stationed at the outpost in order to counter Rebel activity in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Black Epsilon officers included [[Hakasha Sireen]] and [[Prisk Kith'Vys]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Imperial forces launched an attack from the Talus outpost to Corellia where they fought the Rebel [[8th Division]].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=8th Division Lieutenant General}}</ref>

Other Imperial personnel stationed at the outpost after the Battle of Yavin included [[Ceth Laike]], [[Gravin Attal]], [[Lethin Bludder]], [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Edgar]], [[Staff Sergeant/Legends|Staff Sergeant]] [[Rothax]], and [[Xalox Guul]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
